description.zh: 智能接入网关实例地域ID。
description.en: The ID of the region where the Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance is deployed.

description.zh:
对端BGP自治系统编号。

>启用BGP路由协议时需输入。
description.en:
The BGP autonomous system number (ASN) of the peer device.

> You must set this parameter when you enable BGP.

description.zh:
对端IP地址。

>启用BGP路由协议时需输入。
description.en:
The IP address of the peer device.

> You must set this parameter when you enable BGP.

description.zh:
路由协议。取值：

- **STATIC**：静态路由协议。
- **OSPF**：OSPF动态路由协议。
- **BGP**：BGP动态路由协议。
description.en:
The routing protocol. Valid values:

- **STATIC**: uses a static routing protocol.

- **OSPF**: uses the Open Shortest Path First protocol (OSPF).

- **BGP**: uses the Border Gateway Protocol (BGP).
The ID of the SAG instance.

description.zh: 绑定的智能接入网关设备序列号。
description.en: The serial number of the SAG device associated with the SAG instance.
